data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 咖啡店的歌单
data.description: 咖啡还热着，雪菜在纸上列下想唱的几首歌，停笔想了想，又补上一首旧曲。
data.action: writing a song list beside a coffee cup
data.promptProse: Seated at a small round table in a sun-drenched second-floor cafe overlooking a bustling city intersection, Setsuna neatly pens a list of favorite pop ballads onto the back of a paper napkin. A warm ceramic mug of caramel latte with latte art sits beside a silver pen and her phone, while bright morning daylight bathes her radiant, cheerful smile.
